title: Duty cycle tracking
description: Validate lichen_duty_cycle_* APIs for regulatory compliance. Ensure correct permille limits: 1000 (US/CA 100%), 10 (EU 1%), 50 (AU/NZ 5%). Track 32-entry circular buffer of TX timestamps/durations.
close_reason: Already implemented - duty cycle APIs correctly support all regulatory limits (permille 1-1000 for US/CA 100%, EU 1%, AU/NZ 5%). 32-entry circular buffer with head/len tracking implemented in hal_duty.c. Permille validation in lichen_duty_cycle_init() clamps invalid values to default 10 (EU). Tests in test_duty_cycle_ccp13 and test_duty_cycle_tracker_matches_ccp13_vectors validate core functionality.
